findings.observed: Full authorized-index replay with the captured query vector reproduces the frozen index fingerprint and candidate rank5FC5704. Its primary indexed child is5704.2.9.4,546characters, with complete parent context totaling1696characters. Exact block hash and source offsets match canonical body. The actual writer instead receives a truncated4368-character unrelated subsection collection omitting that child and ending mid numbered list.
findings.rootCause: app.mjs researchEvidenceForSectionIDs collapses all whitespace to spaces in canonicalText. research-evidence-assembly.mjs compactText preserves newlines. canonicalIndexedPassage therefore rejects legitimate multiline child/context slices because fullText.includes(slice) compares different whitespace representations, despite exact source-body hash/offset validation succeeding.
findings.genericProposal: Compare canonical containment using one whitespace-only representation on both sides while retaining exact raw block hash, integer source offsets and original passage-text equality. Emit the complete indexed child and its exact retained context atomically. Never fit by discarding exceptions or operative conditions. If complete context exceeds allowance, keep it unresolved. Avoid fallback to unrelated prefixes after a valid indexed child is available.
contracts: Multiline single-block source plus a resolver that returns flattened canonicalText retains a complete decisive child and parent condition within budget.
Exact raw block hash/offset mismatch is rejected despite whitespace normalization.
Altered legal words or added nonexistent context are rejected.
A complete child larger than the allowance remains incomplete; no exception/condition is dropped.
User-pinned selection boundaries and earlier fail-closed oversized dependency contracts remain unchanged.
findings.ownership: Narrow whitespace fix delegated to passage_index; broader fallback/child selection remains assembly owner.
